title: CharacterBody2D: move_and_slide() on wall with high speed is treated as on floor in certain case
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in 4.3 and 4.5 Stable.

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.3.0.stable

### Issue description

Call `move_and_slide()` with persistent high horizontal speed will treat the wall as floor in certain case. This will also clear all the velocity, preventing the gravity acceleration behavior, as shown in video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/caa3da5f-435a-4727-b4a1-3295e26c0278

I've checked the source and I'm pretty sure this is caused by `floor_block_on_wall`. Setting this property to false will resolve the issue.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8d8041bd4dab30e51ecf5be21dc7bf1f6a26c039/scene/2d/physics/character_body_2d.cpp#L183-L200

Since the body has high enough speed, it will fly from the floor to the wall in one frame, causing `p_was_on_floor` to be true while `on_floor` is false. The line 195 `_snap_on_floor(true, false, true)` will exactly treat the wall as floor, setting `on_floor = true` (I've tried printing out `on_floor` after line 195, and it is indeed true in my case). Then the velocity is cleared in line 196, just as the video shown above. But this shouldn't happen, there is no floor to snap at all. I'm not sure what's wrong with `_snap_on_floor(true, false, true)` here.

### Steps to reproduce

The code is simple here:

``` gdscript
extends CharacterBody2D

@export var speed := 1000
@export var gravity := 1000

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	velocity.x = speed
	velocity.y += gravity * delta
	move_and_slide()
````

To reproduce, the body should always be on floor before (make sure `p_was_on_floor` is true while `on_floor` is false), so the gravity is necessary here. Just check out the MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[floor_block_on_wall-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22610791/floor_block_on_wall-bug.zip)
